grandchild_gift_cards.start: Margaret gets a call. The caller says he is her grandson.
grandchild_gift_cards.amber: Decider reads each sentence on this device. Nothing goes to the cloud.
grandchild_gift_cards.red: Now a claimed identity and a plea for secrecy. Two kinds of signal. The gate freezes payments.
grandchild_gift_cards.held: Margaret asks her assistant for a five hundred dollar gift card. The hold stops it, and the balance stays put.
grandchild_gift_cards.messages: Only now does Bedrock write a calm note for Margaret, and a text for her family.
grandchild_gift_cards.end: Every byte sent to the cloud left after the freeze.

real_pharmacy.start: A normal call. Margaret pays a bill while she listens.
real_pharmacy.end: No freeze. The payment goes through.
